tagline: Student explorers for shark science & ocean conservation
notice: Stay up to date with dives, talks, and field events — join the Shark Club list.
introBody:
We are a student-led community dedicated to shark science, ocean literacy, and conservation. We bring curious people together to learn from researchers, build field skills, and advocate for healthy oceans.

Our events are open to students from every background. No marine biology experience—and no scuba certification—is required.

sections.title: Who joins Shark Club?
sections.body:
Undergraduate and graduate students from every field are welcome. Our members include future scientists, filmmakers, divers, designers, educators, and people who simply want to better understand sharks and their place in the ocean.

We share a respect for wildlife, a love of learning, and a commitment to evidence-based conservation.

sections.title: Learn beyond the classroom
sections.body:
Club nights bring researchers, conservation leaders, photographers, and field professionals into the room for honest conversations about their work. Field days turn that knowledge into practice through coastal surveys, species identification, community science, and public outreach.

Leadership roles give members the chance to plan programs, host speakers, and shape the future of the club.

benefitsIntro: Learn alongside working scientists, practice responsible field observation, and meet people who care about sharks as much as you do.
benefits: Research talks and career conversations with shark scientists
Coastal field days, public outreach, and citizen-science projects
Workshops in identification, data skills, science communication, and conservation
joinBody: Come to a meeting, bring your questions, and meet your future field crew. Everyone is welcome.
footerBlurb: For the curious, the conservation-minded, and everyone drawn to the ocean.
meetingInfo: Bi-weekly meetings • Location and time announced with each event
